reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: 使用後覺得質地滿清爽，不會有一般防曬棒厚重或黏膩的感覺，直接塗在臉上很方便，出門補擦也很省時間。控油效果還不錯，塗完肌膚比較乾爽，妝前使用也不太會影響底妝。不過防曬棒還是需要均勻多次塗抹，不能只薄薄帶過。整體使用感舒服，滿適合夏天或需要經常補防曬的人。
reviews.zh: 用完覺得質地幾清爽，唔會似一般防曬棒咁厚重或者黏膩，直接塗喺面度好方便，出門補擦都好慳時間。控油效果幾好，搽完皮膚比較乾爽，化妝前用都唔太影響底妝。不過防曬棒都係要均勻咁多次塗抹，唔可以淨係薄薄咁掃過。整體使用感覺舒服，好啱夏天或者需要經常補防曬嘅人。

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: I felt a noticeable heaviness when I applied it, but the heaviness disappeared after 5 minutes, replaced by a dry and light feeling. I would definitely repurchase it! In addition, it can be used after makeup, which I think is a great advantage as it won't ruin your makeup.
reviews.zh: 搽嗰陣覺得明顯有啲厚重，但係5分鐘之後，嗰種厚重感就冇咗，換成乾爽同輕盈嘅感覺。我一定會回購！另外，化妝之後都可以用，我覺得係好大嘅優點，因為唔會弄花你嘅妝容。

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: 私には合わなかったみたい。一度つかったらぷつぷつがいくつかできました。残念です。
reviews.zh: 好似唔啱我。用過一次就起咗幾粒小疙瘩。好可惜。

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text:
Convenient, effective, and non-drying.
Really impressed with this sun stick! The oil control performance is great without causing any dryness, which is hard to find in mattifying products. It is compact, incredibly handy, and very easy to apply throughout the day without getting your hands messy. A super convenient everyday essential!
reviews.zh:
方便、有效、唔會乾燥。
呢支防曬棒真係令我好驚喜！控油效果好好，又唔會令皮膚乾燥，呢點喺控油類產品入面幾難得。體積細、非常方便攜帶，成日都易用，唔會弄到雙手黏搭搭。係非常方便嘅日常必備品！

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: Lightweight and non-sticky, but the texture is a bit firm, so it’s not as easy to spread.
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈、唔黏，不過質地有啲偏硬，所以唔太容易推開。

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: The first thing I noticed was how comfortable this product feels on the skin. It's not too watery and not too thick, so it's very easy to apply evenly. I have combination skin that can become oily during the day, but this provides hydration without making my face feel heavy. I've been using it both morning and evening, and it fits perfectly into my routine. The packaging is also convenient and easy to use. Overall, I'm very pleased with my purchase and would definitely recommend it to friends and family.
reviews.zh: 我第一時間留意到，呢款產品搽喺皮膚上好舒服。唔會太稀，又唔會太稠，所以好容易搽勻。我係混合性皮膚，日間會出油，但係呢款產品可以補濕，又唔會令面覺得厚重。我朝晚都用，好啱融入我嘅日常。包裝又方便易用。整體嚟講，我對今次購買好滿意，一定會推薦畀親朋戚友。

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: I really like how quick and convenient this sunscreen stick is to use. It glides on smoothly without getting my hands messy, making it perfect for touch-ups throughout the day. It’s easy to carry in my bag, so reapplying sunscreen feels much less of a hassle.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支防曬棒用起嚟又快又方便。推開好順滑，唔會弄到雙手黏搭搭，好啱日間隨時補擦。放落袋入面都易攜帶，所以補擦防曬都冇咁麻煩。

reviews.shade: OBgE Pore Zero Oil Control Sun Stick 18g
reviews.text: I bought this for my husband to take along to Sydney. He has oily skin, and he’s not the best about applying sunscreen, especially re-applying sunscreen. This stick is so light and airy, and there’s no sticky residue. He has been carrying it with him, and even re-applying it. He has even commented on how light and weightless it is. An exceptional product!
reviews.zh: 我買嚟畀我老公帶去悉尼。佢皮膚出油，而且佢唔太擅長擦防曬，尤其係補擦。呢支防曬棒好輕、好透氣，又冇黏膩嘅殘留。佢一直都帶住，仲會補擦。佢仲評論過話，呢支好輕，好似冇重量咁。非常出色嘅產品！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
